g.text: Capture source + settings → FIFO queue → one operation worker
Keep preparing other work · cancel queued jobs before tools start · retry as a new request
Running native tool → bounded progress / stderr pipes
Cancel / timeout → kill + wait → unwind owned temporary files
Stage output → validate → publish without overwrite
Completed / Failed / Cancelled → retain valid outputs → continue next job
Failure never silently changes another job; earlier committed files remain protected
Normal close → cancel unfinished jobs → join native cleanup → flush history
